title: sclerocarya birrea subsp. caffra
intro: Sclerocarya birrea subsp. caffra, commonly known as the Marula tree, is a plant species that belongs to the Anacardiaceae family. This tree is not only a valuable resource for its fruit, but it also provides various health benefits, including antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Sclerocarya birrea subsp. caffra include its use in traditional medicine to treat conditions such as hypertension, diabetes, and gastrointestinal disorders, as well as its potential as an antiviral and anticancer agent. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
